text: Now, the confrontation is direct. At the generous rotation bound and the fiducial galaxy turnaround time, the predicted handedness imbalance is 1.9 parts in 100 million. Even counting all 2 trillion observable galaxies yields only 0.027 standard deviations. A 3 standard deviation detection would need about 25 quadrillion galaxies, roughly 12,000 Favorable choices across the full bracket reach at most 0.08 standard deviations. No survey lever closes that gap.
